title: acetosella insipida
intro: Acetosella insipida, commonly known as the mountain sorrel, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Oxalidaceae. It is traditionally used for its health benefits, which include its ability to act as a diuretic and to help reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Acetosella insipida include its potential to lower blood pressure and to aid in the treatment of urinary tract infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include oxalic acid and other flavonoids, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
